title: Olive Plants a Seed
checkpoint: Reception Summer 2, week 2 — Phase 4: With long vowel sounds: adjacent consonants in words with long vowel sounds (no new sounds)
note_for_grown_ups: Phase 4 complete, 76-sound stage (nd, nt, nk, ft, lt, lf just added).

pages.illustration: Moss the hedgehog carefully pressing a small seed into a hole in the vegetable patch.

pages.text: Moss digs a bit, and pops the seed in.
pages.illustration: Moss the hedgehog digging a small hole and dropping the seed inside.

pages.text: Olive wants to plant one too.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl watching Moss, holding her own seed in one claw.
Olive the owl scratching a shallow hole in the soil.

pages.text: Olive pops the seed in, but it sits on top.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl dropping her seed into the shallow hole, the seed resting visibly on the surface.

pages.text: The seed is not in the mud yet.
pages.illustration: Close view of Olive's seed sitting exposed on top of the soil.
Moss the hedgehog leaning over, showing Olive how deep to dig.

pages.text: Olive digs it in, and pats it flat.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl pressing the soil flat over her now properly buried seed.

pages.text: Olive and Moss grin at the plant.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl and Moss the hedgehog looking pleased at two neat patches of soil.
